Behind the Scenes 🎥

Nexar was founded in 2015 by Eran Shir, a serial entrepreneur, and Bruno Fernandez-Ruiz, formerly a Senior Fellow at Yahoo!.

We are backed by world-class investors such as Aleph, Mosaic, Slow, True, Alibaba, Ibex, Banca Generali, Valor, Atreides Management, Regah Ventures, Nationwide Insurance, Corner Ventures, Qumra Capital, Sienna Venture Capital, State Farm, and Catalyst.
